item.title: Faculty group demands protections for non-citizens who ‘express support’ for Hamas
item.description: A national faculty coalition is pushing to grant non-citizens First Amendment protections, demanding that the Trump administration be permanently barred from revoking visas over pro-Palestinian activism or support for terrorist groups. The initiative is led by the American Association of University Professors and several of its university chapters, including Harvard’s, in partnership with the Middle […]

item.title: Augsburg U. criticizes ‘disturbing’ ICE arrest of ‘registered sex offender’ student
item.description: Minnesota university calls ICE arrest of student 'profoundly disturbing' - except he is a sex offender.

item.title: U. Maryland opens ‘Black & Indigenous’ art gallery to address ‘climate anxiety’
item.description: The University of Maryland's new art gallery is dedicated to 'Black and Indigenous' environmental art. However, outside scholars criticize it for promoting only one perspective about climate change.

item.title: 14 elite colleges given F grades in antisemitism ‘report card’
item.description: 'The 2025 findings prove that antisemitism on campus is systemic, not episodic,' report states.

item.title: University of Nebraska Lincoln cuts four programs, but keeps -$800,000 ROI degree
item.description: University of Nebraska-Lincoln moved forward with its plan to cut the statistics program while it continues to offer its worst performing degree.

item.title: Turning Point USA leaders forced off campus at Illinois university after death threats
item.description: Leaders of a Turning Point USA chapter at Olivet Nazarene University have been forced off campus for their safety after receiving death threats. University officials are investigating the threats and gave chapter president Jacob York accommodations to finish the semester virtually, Fox News reported. The chapter’s vice president, Mara Hudson, who manages the group’s Instagram […]

item.title: Columbia re-opens campus 2 years after anti-Israel protests prompted lockdowns
item.description: Columbia University has reopened its campus after two years of turmoil following pro-Palestinian protests. Meanwhile, one Jewish student says there's still a need to discipline faculty who supported the discrimination.

item.title: Santa Clara law school offers scholarships after Trump capped student loans
item.description: At least one law school is already lowering tuition in reaction to Trump's new budget bill.

item.title: New book shows how academic medicine and medical schools are ‘doing great harm’
item.description: A new book provides the average reader with the facts about DEI and gender ideology in medicine - and why that is harmful.

item.title: Students allege discrimination for ‘Jewish sounding’ last names at Chapman U.
item.description: Two Chapman University graduates filed a federal lawsuit alleging discrimination based on their Jewish identities. They claim the university failed to address ongoing antisemitism, including harassment from Students for Justice in Palestine.
